title: 《吞噬星空》完本免费看啦！
content_zh:
我的书《吞噬星空》就要在10月10号到10月13号在免费频道参加限时免费活动，回馈一直支持番茄的粉丝读者们，届时大家可以免费

特别感谢这些年来对番茄不离不弃支持的兄弟姐妹们，所以番茄这次一次性把自己的六本书拿出来做一次大型限时免费

一旁毛利兰和柯南也走了过来，听闻彦非和服部平次的话，瞬间竖起耳朵，打算听一下彦非说些什么。

于是，接下来一家人一边吃着烧烤一边喝着啤酒，聊着白仁宗的工作。

时不时有玩具道兵的兵器被牵引的拦住同伴的进攻路线，索清秋就会抓住机会一击双杀手，带走对手。

陈倩倩点头，将红色粉色黄色白色绿色都给了沈如意，自己则拿了紫色和蓝色，至于灰色和黑色，都是沈奥奇他们的。

见他视线刚好落在她的身上，一双眼睛清凉透彻，像是能直接看透她的心里。

沈如意想把遇到沈蓉幽的事情告诉陈倩倩，没想到刚到这里听到了那两个倒霉催的声音。

刚刚还因为名冢彦一句“我们说正事”而提起精神的泉悠月，一下子无精打采起来。

白仁宗坐在电脑前，屏幕上能映照出他的脸，剑眉星目和高挺的鼻梁，五官相当帅气，只是此时专心打游戏的他表情略显呆滞，身材稍显消瘦，因为长期熬夜留下了深深的黑眼圈。

自己筑基连续失败两次，必须要丹药辅助，现在只好忍气吞声，等境界上去后再收拾这个废物。

一个主家之人，被自己从至高天里请了出来，如今却惨败在了自己的地盘。

而叶秋打篮球那么厉害，如果叶秋肯上场，百分百会赢的。但是，李芊芊知道叶秋并不想打，那也是有些可惜。

当然了，如果是乘着市场行情好，抛售股票可能是能赚更多。但是，林棋并不会这么做。

前一秒还叫嚣着要怎么收拾白羽的洪儒太，后一秒已经死了，被斩杀，头颅落地。

在剑修们的攻击队列之后，灵儿蹦跶儿的跟在后面，笑眯眯的动手剖开龙狼尸体，收集着金属性妖灵石。这活她愿意干，因为这些可全都是她的零食呀铁甲龙狼一共有上百只，那就有上百个妖灵石喽，够灵儿吃好一阵子的了。

在罗本先生带着露易丝在里面到处转一转的时候，露易丝觉得很不错，很适合那些职员上班。

也所以，能潜入到九百尺就行修炼的明右之、祖君子等等，就会在那里留下姓名了。

那个大嘴巴男子，眼睛贼溜溜地看了一眼阿尔维斯，轻轻地努了努嘴，暗示着什么。

林少举起了自己的剑，没人注意上面闪过的一摸黑光，之后，它便狠狠地斩了下去。

“去！”就在唐装老头为此迷惑不解，心神分散之时，严泓源趁机驱动金色神针对他进行了突袭。刹那间，那些悬浮在他身周的无数金针立刻如出膛子弹般，挟带着无穷杀意，从各个方位向他狂涌而去。

可是学长就是人多势众，也不知道他能不能打赢，要是因为救她受伤，她心里真是过意不去。

沈明笑呵呵的瞥了李总一眼，眼神玩味。李总脸上也得笑意，对着郭妃俪和郑秀胗的背影扬了扬下巴。

不管是张召林还是沈明，俩人看在袁和评的面子上，算是暂时把对对方的不满，藏在了肚子里。

My book "Swallowing the Stars" will participate in a limited-time free event on the free channel from October 10th to October 13th to give back to fans and readers who have always supported Tomato. At that time, everyone can enjoy it for free

Special thanks to the brothers and sisters who have supported Tomato over the years, so Tomato is taking out six of its books at once for a large-scale limited-time free sale.

Mao Lilan and Conan also walked over. After hearing what Yan Fei and Hattori Heiji said, they immediately pricked up their ears and planned to listen to what Yan Fei said.

So next, the family ate barbecue and drank beer, chatting about Bai Renzong's work.

From time to time, a toy Taoist soldier's weapon would be pulled to block the attack route of his companions. Suo Qingqiu would seize the opportunity to kill the opponent with one strike and take away the opponent.

Chen Qianqian nodded and gave red, pink, yellow, white and green to Shen Ruyi, while she took purple and blue. As for gray and black, they all belonged to Shen Aoqi and the others.

Seeing that his eyes happened to fall on her body, his eyes were cool and clear, as if he could see directly into her heart.

Shen Ruyi wanted to tell Chen Qianqian about her encounter with Shen Ronyou, but she didn't expect to hear those two unlucky voices when she arrived here.

Izumi Yuyue, who had just been cheered up by Nazukahiko's words "Let's get down to business," suddenly became listless.

Bai Renzong was sitting in front of the computer. His face could be seen on the screen, with pointed eyebrows and starry eyes and a high bridge of nose. His facial features were quite handsome. However, as he was concentrating on playing games, his expression was slightly dull and his figure was slightly thin. He had deep dark circles under his eyes due to staying up late for a long time.

I failed to build the foundation twice in a row and had to use pills to assist me. Now I have to swallow my anger and wait for the realm to be improved before cleaning up this waste.

A member of the master's family was invited out from the highest heaven by him, but now he was defeated miserably in his own territory.

And Ye Qiu is so good at basketball. If Ye Qiu is willing to play, he will definitely win.However, Li Qianqian knew that Ye Qiu didn't want to fight, which was a pity.

Of course, if you take advantage of the good market conditions, you may make more money by selling stocks.However, Lin Qi would not do this.

Hong Rutai, who was clamoring about how to deal with Bai Yu one second, was dead the next second. She was beheaded and her head fell to the ground.

After the attack queue of the sword cultivators, Ling'er jumped behind and started to cut open the dragon and wolf corpse with a smile, collecting the metallic demon spirit stones.She is willing to do this job, because these are all her snacks. There are hundreds of armored dragons and wolves, and there are hundreds of demon spirit stones, which is enough for Ling'er to eat for a long time.

When Mr. Robben took Louise around inside, Louise felt that it was very good and suitable for those employees to work.

Therefore, Ming Youzhi, Zu Junzi, etc., who can sneak into nine hundred feet to practice, will leave their names there.

The man with the big mouth glanced at Alves furtively and pursed his lips slightly, hinting at something.

Mr. Lin raised his sword, and no one noticed the black light flashing above it, and then it slashed down hard.

"Go!" Just when the old man in Tang suit was confused and distracted by this, Yan Hongyuan took the opportunity to drive the golden god to launch a surprise attack on him.In an instant, the countless golden needles floating around him were like discharged bullets, carrying endless killing intent and rushing towards him from all directions.

But even though the senior was outnumbered, she didn't know if he could win. If he was injured while saving her, she would really feel bad.

Shen Ming glanced at Mr. Li with a smile and a playful look in his eyes.Mr. Li also had a smile on his face and raised his chin at the backs of Guo Feili and Zheng Xiuxian.

Whether it was Zhang Zhaolin or Shen Ming, both of them temporarily hid their dissatisfaction with each other for the sake of Yuan Heping.
